scope: independent root audit of the ordered-cutoff stabilizer, formal Kummer-mode descent obstruction, split-cyclotomic invariant countermodel, marked/unmarked distinction, chart accounting, replay, and capacity interpretation

checks.root_repairs: Canonicalized the package and replay command, and narrowed the field-of-definition language to the formal mode-labelled cutoff support. The theorem does not exclude accidental formula-specific identities among evaluated conjugates.

mathematical_audit.stabilizer: If a unit a stabilizes {0,...,m}, its least positive residue A lies in [1,m]. For A>=2, k=floor(m/A)+1 lies in [1,m], while m<Ak<=2m<N, contradicting stabilization. Thus A=1.
mathematical_audit.formal_orbit: Distinct Kummer modes and the trivial support stabilizer give orbit size phi(p-1) for the formal ordered-cutoff support. This is not promoted to an unconditional orbit-size assertion for the evaluated residual.
mathematical_audit.proper_descent: Every nontrivial descent subgroup moves the formal cutoff support, so no proper subfield preserves the exact mode-labelled prefix. A formula-specific coincidence among specialized conjugates remains logically possible.
mathematical_audit.split_model: Since p is congruent to 1 modulo p-1, p splits completely in Q(mu_(p-1)). CRT tuples related by a nontrivial H-conjugation have identical complete unmarked H-invariant data but opposite vanishing at the selected coordinate.
mathematical_audit.trace_norm_slopes: Trace can cancel; norm detects a zero somewhere in the conjugate packet; symmetric, characteristic-polynomial, Newton-slope, and unmarked unit-root data forget which factor is selected. A marked factor retains the condition but is not a descent.
mathematical_audit.scope: The CRT models close only the unmarked invariant-information class. They are not asserted to be values of the actual residual Xi, so an actual formula-specific relation or marked nonconcentration theorem remains live.
mathematical_audit.chart_accounting: The chosen-prime residual is the nondegenerate chart, while Item 349 supplies a distinct degenerate gate. Controlling only one chart cannot book a whole-ray saving; the full one-ray reward remains 1/210 and the proved gain is zero.
